svg.title: Map of Permitopolis
svg.desc: Schematic city map, not to scale. Downtown runs along Main Street from 1st to 6th Avenue, with City Hall Plaza at 1st Avenue. River Road loops south along the river past Riverside Park and the boathouse. Maple Street, Elm Street and Oak Avenue are residential. The Great Lawn sits at the west end of Elm Street.

g.text: Schematic city map, not to scale
